dashboard.description: This Dashboards cover todays event count, To drilldown further click in the KPIs.

search.query: | tstats count from datamodel=Remote_Access_Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.EventCode="4648" by _time Authentication.EventCode Authentication.ComputerName Authentication.Process_Name Authentication.src_nt_domain Authentication.src_user Authentication.user Authentication.dest_nt_domain Authentication.dest Authentication.action | `Drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename src_nt_domain as Domain src_user as Dest_Host user as Src_Account dest_nt_domain as Source_System_Name dest as Target action as Action count as Count ComputerName as Src_Host | eval Event_Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | search Src_Host="DC*.dsu.ccdc" Process_Name="C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe" | table Event_Time Src_Account Src_Host Domain Dest_Host Target Action Count|timechart count span=1d

| tstats count from datamodel=Remote_Access_Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.EventCode="4625" by _time Authentication.EventCode Authentication.src_nt_domain Authentication.src_user Authentication.src Authentication.user Authentication.dest_nt_domain Authentication.dest Authentication.action Authentication.signature Authentication.Process_Name Authentication.Source_Port Authentication.Logon_Type Authentication.ComputerName | `Drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename src_nt_domain as Source_Domain src_user as Source_System src as Src_Host user as Src_Account dest_nt_domain as Domain dest as Dest_Host signature as Failure_Reason Process_Name as ProcessName Source_Port as Port Logon_Type as LogonType action as Action count as Count | eval Event_Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | search ProcessName IN ("-","C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe") ComputerName="DC*.dsu.ccdc" Port IN ("-",0) | search LogonType!="4" Src_Host!="unknown" | table Event_Time Src_Account Src_Host Domain Dest_Host Action LogonType Failure_Reason Count |timechart count span=1d

| tstats count from datamodel=Login_Failures where "Disabled" OR "locked" by _time Loginfailed.Account_Name Loginfailed.ComputerName Loginfailed.Failure_Reason | search Loginfailed.Account_Name!="-" | rename Loginfailed.Account_Name as "Account Name" Loginfailed.ComputerName as "Computer Name" Loginfailed.Failure_Reason as "Failure Reason"|timechart count span=1d

index=wineventlog* EventCode=4624 | eval matched="0" | stats c by _time Account_Name ComputerName src_ip Account_Domain action matched | join type=left Account_Name [| inputlookup User_list.csv | eval matched="1" | table Account_Name matched] | search matched!="1" AND Account_Name!="-" AND Account_Name!="*$" AND Account_Name!="system" AND Account_Name!="*firewall*" AND Account_Name!="*ldap*" AND Account_Name!="UMFD*" AND Account_Name!="admin*" AND Account_Name!="DWM*" AND Account_Domain!="-" AND Account_Domain!=`domain`|fields - matched c|timechart count span=1d

`Domain-Controller-Security-index` source="*Power*" "ComputerName"="*" | rex field=_raw "User =\s+.*\\\(?<Username>.*)" | search Username!="SYSTEM" | rex field=_raw "Message=(?<Inputs>[\D\d\n]*)Context" | rex field=_raw "User =\s+.*\\\(?<Username>.*)" | search Username!="SYSTEM" | rex field=_raw "Message=(?<Inputs>[\D\d\n]*)Context" | rex field=Message mode=sed "s/CommandInvocation\(//g" | rex field=Message mode=sed "s/\)://g" | rex field=_raw "Host\s+Application\s+=\s+.*\\\(?<Application>.*)" | stats c by _time Username ComputerName Message Inputs Application|timechart count span=1d
